notes.title: Cyber Siege – Demo is out now
notes.content: [p]We’re excited to announce that the Cyber Siege demo is now available to download![/p][p][/p][p]🔹 Platforms: Windows, macOS, and Linux (fully playable on Steam Deck)[/p][p]🔹 What’s included: an introductory tutorial and the first 2 full levels[/p][p]🔹 We’d love your feedback: please share your thoughts through our [url="https://solardragon.eu/feedback"]feedback form[/url][/p][p][/p][p]We don’t see the demo as a one-time showcase – we plan to maintain and update it as development progresses.[/p][p][/p][p]💡 Tips to get the most out of the demo:[/p][list][*][p]Try it on a higher difficulty if you’re up for a challenge[/p][/*][*][p]Play local co-op with up to 4 players – guaranteed chaos![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you for your support, and we can’t wait to hear what you think! ❤️[/p]

notes.title: How We Build Levels
notes.content: [p]Every battle needs a proper battlefield.[/p][p][/p][p]When we started working on Cyber Siege, we quickly ran into a problem: how to create levels efficiently.[/p][p]At first, we tried building everything directly in Unity, but it soon became clear that this approach was unsustainable and way too slow.[/p][p]In the end, we came up with our own workflow:[/p][p][/p][p]1) First, we design the map in the Tiled editor – it almost looks like an old-school “paper plan.”[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621289/581f6d388ba5617746e0125c5ac83650092a6794.png"][/img][/p][p]2) Then we bring it into Unity, where it automatically generates a 3D scene.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621289/58fac466644912dbc47386c92beec2d08eceba00.png"][/img][/p][p]3) Finally, we add decorations, lights, and animated objects to make the environment feel alive.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621289/eafde0f056e7c13d89e60776d46b56935227ae01.png"][/img][/p][p]Thanks to this system, our levels aren’t just flat – they include bridges, stairs, and elevated walkways, which means you can expect vertical combat and more interesting environments.[/p][p][/p][p]For us, this workflow saves a huge amount of time – and for you as players, it means more diverse maps and greater combat possibilities.[/p][p]What do you think the ideal level for a co-op shooter should look like? More like an open arena, or a maze of twisting corridors?[/p][p]Let us know in the comments – your ideas inspire us![/p][p][/p][p]If Cyber Siege caught your attention, we’d be very grateful if you add it to your wishlist:[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3465820/Cyber_Siege/" style="button"]Steam store page[/url][/p]

notes.title: Cyber Siege fully localized in Czech
notes.content: [p]We’ve got great news for all Czech players – Cyber Siege is fully localized in Czech! 🇨🇿[/p][p]You will enjoy all menus, texts and messages in the game in your native language.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621289/fa3ad2786036de007bcd530d9adc9753855ccdf2.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621289/4d34d8699ec126536afc9b9554152b9e058c722f.png"][/img][/p][p]Add the game to your wishlist and get ready for launch.[/p]

notes.title: 🔫 ENEMY SPOTLIGHT: SOLDIER 🔫
notes.content:
Simple. Deadly.

The Soldier is the basic shooting enemy unit in Cyber Siege – but don’t let that fool you. He’s quick to shoot, patrols in squads, and if you’re not careful, he’ll force you into a corner fast.

🧠 Smart behavior – seeks cover and works with others
🔫 Attacks from medium range
🚨 Appears early in the game – but never underestimate him
